product.title: Maui Whale Watch & Snorkel from Ma'alaea Harbor Pride of Maui

description.text: Join the Pride of Maui for a premium whale watching and snorkeling experience aboard Maui's largest and most stable Maxi Power Catamaran. With 360-degree panoramic views, snorkeling at a vibrant coral reef, and a full barbecue lunch, this half-day tour offers memories that last a lifetime. Stops include Ma'alaea Harbor, Whale Watching Waters, Coral Reef Snorkel Site. Enjoy spacious decks, first-class service, and amenities like a water slide, warm showers, and snorkeling gear provided for all guests. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
